messages:
Maya Chen: Thanks for the all-hands. Quick follow-up: can someone clarify the delivery windows for the next API surface changes, Console feature parity for Optimize, and the rollback/fallback plan for the Dedicated rollout?
Elena Patel: Short version: API incremental changes -> canary in 2 weeks, beta in 6 weeks, GA in ~12 weeks. Console parity for Optimize features is targeted mid-beta so customers on Dedicated can use them before GA.
Sam Ortiz: Can you clarify what "canary" means operationally here? Is that 1% traffic or specific customers?
Elena Patel: Canary = internal + opt-in beta customers (~5% of traffic). We'll recruit a handful of large customers for early validation.
Ravi Singh: Blockers for canary are mostly infra: rollout orchestration and the per-route throttling fix. Those get fixed in the upcoming eng sprint; if no regressions we start canary.
Jordan Lee: Deployment plan: canary region = us-west2 only. If stable 72h -> expand to us-east1 and eu-west1. We'll have an automated rollback policy that switches to the previous model variant + clears KV cache for affected nodes.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for api/v2-routing at 1809998920.
Sam Ortiz: For Console parity: which Optimize controls are in beta vs. behind feature flags? Specifically asking about batching presets and quantization profiles.
Elena Patel: Batching presets (low/med/high) -> available in beta. Quantization profiles (auto suggestions + per-model recommendations) -> behind feature flags initially, will unlock during canary expansion.
Maya Chen: Is there a docs release tied to the canary? Need to coordinate customer comms + SDK updates.
Elena Patel: Yes — docs refresh and SDK patch will land day 0 of public beta. We'll post release notes and a short migration guide (examples + p60 latency numbers).
Ravi Singh: FYI: the KV cache flush is part of the rollback steps; we also added a safety knob to disable batching per-model at runtime should we see perf regressions.
Jordan Lee: Ops will open a dedicated incident channel for the canary window and we'll run 24/7 rotation for the first expansion.
Sam Ortiz: Any known risks to Dedicated customers during canary? We want to avoid config drift.
Elena Patel: Dedicated customers on pinned versions are unaffected unless they opt into the new runtime. For those who opt in, we provide a testing checklist and a rollback path that doesn’t touch their dedicated pools unless explicitly rolled.
Maya Chen: Can we get an executive summary slide for the next partner sync? I can draft + Elena can review.
Elena Patel: Yes please — Maya draft, I'll add timelines. Also scheduling a 30-min office hours next Tue to go over migration and SDK changes.
Sam Ortiz: Thanks — please post calendar invite.
Maya Chen: Will do. Closing thread — we’ll track action items in the release plan doc. :thumbsup:
